editorial.description_en: Young edible greens, at the chroma that makes them look worth picking.
editorial.description_ja: 春のわか菜のような、あざやかな黄緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.830, C 0.092, h 122.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 春 (haru, spring) + 菜 (na, greens). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Spring Greens" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 春菜. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — shin-me at ΔE00 4.2, hina-gusa at ΔE00 5.6, ko-more-bi at ΔE00 7.3. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (302°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
